MB-GATE-CANONICAL-INGEST-001 (Option B: wrapper snapshot canonical)

Purpose
- Accept canonical snapshots shipped as wrapper ZIPs containing MANIFEST.json and CANONICAL_SNAPSHOT/canonical_os.zip
- Materialize a canonical OS root by extracting the nested canonical payload to a deterministic location

Deterministic materialization target
- <OUT_ROOT>/canonical_tree/  (flat OS tree after materialization)
- <OUT_ROOT>/canonical_os.zip (cached payload, optional for re-derivation)
- <OUT_ROOT>/MANIFEST.json    (copied if present)

Fail-closed
- Missing input zip => FAIL
- Wrapper payload present but MANIFEST required and missing => FAIL
- Unknown format => FAIL

Inputs
- input zip (wrapper or flat)

Outputs
- receipt JSON (validated by canonical_ingest_receipt.schema.json)
